the settled bucket is accounted for by its two readings
transport's placed and listed names cover its live members once

every sampled moved name is hand-read
no proposed part name duplicates a stored group's string

the source container appears only in source IDSs

spans_parts.name: planted_transport_spanning
spans_parts.reason: its sources read more than one group: profile_quantities + source_quantities

double_count.description: Negative control: a planted name inserted into two parts makes --check --plant-double-count exit 1.

read_only.description: Every statement the run hands the graph is checked for a write clause before it is sent; a match fails the run.

distribution_quantities.definition: the distribution-function quantities a distributions structure holds: the distribution itself and its orbit-class moments

profile_quantities.definition: the profiles a profile structure holds: the one- and two-dimensional profile quantities and their general-grid forms

source_quantities.definition: the source terms a sources structure holds: the particle, energy, momentum and current rates a source adds to the plasma

summary_quantities.definition: the summary forms a summary structure holds: local values at named locations and the volume-, line- and flux-surface-averaged or integrated forms of a profile quantity

transport_coefficients.definition: the transport-model quantities a transport model structure holds: diffusivities, conductivities, convection velocities and damping rates

rule.statement: a name's group is read from the data structures of its sources

rows.description: Number-density-weighted mean ionic charge number over the charge-state distribution of a specified ion population.

judgment.why: a density-weighted mean ion charge is a profile-like average over a charge-state population, and its no-source form is the parent of profile children; the stored transport domain names no structure it comes from

rows.name: average_charge_number

rows.description: Bulk translational velocity vector of neutral particles in one specified internal quantum or energy state, given by the first moment of their velocity distribution.

judgment.why: a bulk velocity of neutrals in one internal state is computed on a profile grid, so the profile structures' reading names where it sits; the stored transport domain names no structure it comes from

rows.name: bulk_neutral_internal_state_velocity

rows.description: Non-inductive plasma current enclosed by a magnetic flux surface, combining signed bootstrap, neutral-beam, and wave-driven contributions.

judgment.why: the non-inductive current inside a flux surface is a source structure's cumulative integral of the driven current; it is not a transport model quantity

rows.name: cumulative_inside_flux_surface_current_due_to_non_inductive_current_drive

rows.description: Cumulative electron particle source rate is the net production or removal of free electrons integrated over the plasma volume enclosed by a magnetic flux surface.

judgment.why: the source structures state the particle source and its cumulative inside-surface form directly, so the rule reads the structure that holds the quantity

rows.name: cumulative_inside_flux_surface_electron_particle_source_rate

rows.description: Co-passing fast-particle current density is the signed conventional electric-charge flux per unit area carried by fast particles on co-passing, untrapped guiding-center orbits. It is a vector orbit-class contribution and excludes compensating electron and thermal-ion return currents.

judgment.why: the current is an orbit-class moment of the distribution function, stated in the distributions structures; the stored transport domain does not say what structure holds it

rows.name: co_passing_fast_current_density

rows.description: Flux-surface-averaged rate of Coulomb-collisional energy transfer per unit volume from co-passing fast particles to fast ions of one specified species and charge state.

judgment.why: the collisional power density on co-passing fast ions is stated inside the distributions structure, one level below the distribution itself, so distribution_quantities is its structure's group

rows.name: co_passing_fast_ion_charge_state_power_density_due_to_collisions

rows.description: Number density of argon ions across all charged ionization states, excluding neutral argon. It is the general argon-ion concentration shared by its local and spatially averaged forms.

judgment.why: its no-source form is the parent of the summary structures' local and volume-averaged argon densities, so the rule reads the summary structures that hold every form of this density; the part is named for what a summary structure holds, not for the physical quantity

rows.name: argon_density

rows.description: Particle number density of argon ions evaluated at the magnetic axis is the local argon-ion count per physical volume at that location, summed over all argon ionic charge states.

judgment.why: the quantity is stated only under summary/local, so the summary structure is the reading; a local density at a named location is exactly the class a summary structure holds

rows.name: argon_density_at_magnetic_axis

rows.description: Diamagnetic component of the electrical conductivity in the edge plasma.

judgment.why: the conductivity is stated under the transport model's conductivity container, which is the transport coefficient structure itself

rows.name: diamagnetic_conductivity

rows.description: Effective velocity coefficient for diamagnetic, advective, non-diffusive transport of selected momentum populations, components, and transport directions.

judgment.why: the coefficient for diamagnetic advective momentum transport is stated under core_transport/model, the transport coefficient structure

rows.name: diamagnetic_momentum_convection_velocity

rows.description: Change in ion-state mean ionization potential is the signed difference between the concentration-weighted mean cumulative ionization potential of an ion charge-state bundle after and before a specified state change.

judgment.why: the quantity is a signed change in an ion-state mean potential, stated by a core_instant_changes change structure over a profile grid; its DD home reads as core plasma physics, so the rule's reading is the closer one even though the container is a change rather than a profile

rows.name: change_in_ion_state_mean_ionisation_potential

rows.description: Additional diffusion coefficient accounting for enhanced electron-temperature, electron-density, and ion-temperature transport within a neoclassical tearing mode magnetic island.

judgment.why: the quantity is a transport diffusion coefficient that an NTM enhances; its DD home is the ntms IDS, so a rule reading only the structure files a transport coefficient under magnetohydrodynamics. The stored transport reading is right and the rule's is wrong

rows.name: diffusion_coefficient_due_to_neoclassical_tearing_mode

rows.description: Local electromagnetic radiation power emitted by the electron population per unit volume, without specifying a particular radiation mechanism.

judgment.why: the emitted power density is stated by a radiation process structure over a ggd grid; its DD home is core plasma physics, not a diagnostics domain, so the rule's reading is right and the stored transport domain names no structure it comes from

rows.name: electron_emissivity

parts.definition: the transport-model quantities a transport model structure holds: diffusivities, conductivities, convection velocities and damping rates
the profiles a profile structure holds: the one- and two-dimensional profile quantities and their general-grid forms
the distribution-function quantities a distributions structure holds: the distribution itself and its orbit-class moments
the summary forms a summary structure holds: local values at named locations and the volume-, line- and flux-surface-averaged or integrated forms of a profile quantity
the source terms a sources structure holds: the particle, energy, momentum and current rates a source adds to the plasma

vocabulary.note: core_plasma_physics and edge_plasma_physics name plasma regions, not structures; this part holds the profile structures of every region, so an edge profile and a core profile share it while their regions do not
transport today holds the source IDSs' domain, so the sources' quantities sit inside transport unnamed; this part names the quantity class and narrows transport to it

fast_particles is the domain the DD's IDS map gives the distributions IDS; the distributions structure holds every distribution and its moments, thermal and suprathermal alike, so the part is wider than fast particles and does not duplicate it
general is the DD's fallback domain for the summary IDS and names no quantity; this part names what a summary structure holds
transport names the whole operator class; this part holds only the transport model structures' coefficients, so it is a stricter member of transport and not its duplicate
